title: Canonical evaluation of ordinary common-stage sections at a geometric point
statement: Fix a finite-field datum $D$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme $Y_0$, its geometric fibre $Y$, and an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$ as in [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. For a common-stage Weil complex $K$ of [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex], a compactification presentation $c_0$, and a $k$-point $z:\operatorname{Spec}k\to Y$, define $\operatorname{ev}_z:H^0(Y,K)\to H^0(K_{\bar z})$, with source the ordinary cohomology module underlying [def-weil-global-geometric-frobenius] and target the stalk of [def-weil-local-frobenius-trace]. At the literal finite coefficient stage, construct the integral germ by the inverse pullback identity comparison, the equality $z a_Y=1$, the pullback composition comparison of [lem-trf-integral-pullback-comparison-realization], and pullback of the ordinary direct-image adjunction counit. The counit is the realization comparison followed by the whole-system counit and the inverse completeness unit. Rationalize that germ and take $H^0$, using the recorded coefficient cohomology [def-weil-coefficient-cohomology-modules]. Extend scalars to $\Omega$ and use the recorded source and stalk comparisons. The scalar-size comparison between the lifted coefficient module functor of [lem-weil-frobenius-cohomology-transport-iso] and ordinary scalar extension is the unique natural isomorphism sending $\operatorname{up}(a)\otimes\operatorname{up}(m)$ to $a\otimes m$. Cohomology and tensor-tower comparisons are those of [lem-weil-cohomology-commutes-scalar-extension]. This defines the evaluation on all complexes, including identity coefficient embeddings and zero objects.
